incident_spec.summary: MySQL creates a high percentage of temporary tables on disk during query execution, potentially due to configuration settings or query patterns.
symptoms: High percentage of temporary tables created on disk.
Performance concerns related to disk-based temporary tables.
incident_spec.mechanism: MySQL uses the MEMORY storage engine for in-memory temporary tables and MyISAM for disk-based temporary tables. Disk-based temporary tables are created when TEXT/BLOB fields are present, when the size of the temporary table exceeds `tmp_table_size` or `max_heap_table_size`, or when certain query patterns (e.g., GROUP BY, ORDER BY) involve large columns.
